provenance: Four purposeful manufactured prescribed-power numerical fixtures and one per-segment temporal-refinement family fixed before production; no physical calibration.
scope: One stationary patch, supplied constant areal heat capacity and zero activation energy; finite prescribed nonnegative power only; no conduction, radiation, phase transition, mechanical work, MHD, host transaction, plasma, chemistry or spectra.
schedule_time_convention: Raw JSON decimal endpoints must exactly tile [0,duration_s] before projection. Explicitly checked finite binary64 endpoints then define the library schedule. Logical internal step times are exact rational divisions of those represented endpoints; saved time_s is their rounded display stamp.

cases.purpose: Exactly empty inventory under finite constant input; all release/debit channels remain zero and thermal increase follows input.
